Name: FS - Roley's horns
Author: Roleymoth
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#c27ba0]ABOUT[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mods adds your game 10 different horns for your farmer. Horns can be selected with the [u][b]hand mirror[/b][/u] from the fashion sense mod, this is bought from Pierres or Haley left in your mailbox [img]https://i.imgur.com/dRt6lC5.png[/img][/color]

[size=4][b][color=#6fa8dc]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You get RAR file > Extract files > drop file in stardew valley's mod folder.[/color]

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] are required for this mod to work[/color]
